changes: The interface is now available in English. Choose the language in the profile, under "Language": Russian or English; Telegram notifications arrive in the chosen language.
New accounts and the sign-in pages are in English by default; the sign-in page has a language switch.
A new dark theme, "Pixel night", in the style of the icon: a dark background, a red accent and pixel hearts. Choose it in the profile, under "Theme".
A new app icon — a pixel heart on a dark background, the same for every theme.
The question about your own mood is sent with a button on the "Mine" tab; the double press on the mood card was removed, and the card asks the partner right away again.
In the wishlist a photo opens full-screen, and the description field became a "Product link" with a button that opens the shop.
The chore draw wheel became a roulette: the partners' names alternate four times around.
The draw result is announced full-screen with confetti; a line with the performer and an "Open the duty" button stays under the wheel.

A streak with a flame: a day counts when both recorded their mood; the flame grows with the streak (spark, little flame, flame, bonfire, star flame), and a broken streak can be restored — up to five days a month.
Date wheel: collect up to twelve ideas, the wheel picks one, and you can turn it into an invitation right away.

Reward shop: each partner lists what they are ready to do for hearts and sets a price; the other buys a reward — a paid request is created, hearts are reserved after agreement and deducted after the check.

Memorable dates: relationship and wedding anniversaries and your own dates with a countdown, the nearest one shown on the home screen; the bot reminds you three days before and on the day itself at 09:00.
The home screen got a "Rewards" quick action.
The profile got a theme choice: "Pumpkin latte" (default), "White", "Love" and "Floral". Only colours, the background and decorations change; the layout stays the same, and only you see your choice.
The partner's compliment is shown right under the greeting instead of the phrase "Care starts with small things"; the separate compliment card was removed.
The home screen got "Remind" and "Compliments" quick actions; compliments for the partner moved from the profile to a separate page.
You can set the times of mood questions yourself: from one to eight options with minute precision, separately for each partner.
The double press on the mood card became more reliable: the second press gets half a second, and a refusal shows the exact reason.

The request page looks like the duty card: a heading with the request text, whose it is and who answers, the stages "created → answer → completion", details as a list and cancellation as a separate section.
The app is now called «Любимость»: the new name is in the header, page titles, on the offline screen and in the installed app.
A new icon — a glowing heart on a dark background with autumn leaves; an already installed app may update its icon and name only after being reinstalled.

The duty card explains whose request it is, shows the confirm button right away (disabled until the partner marks it done) and lets you cancel the request; an accepted request from the list opens its duty directly.

The partner's mood is shown as a month calendar with the selected day's entries; on the home screen one press on the card asks the partner, a double press sends the question to yourself, and a hold opens the calendar.
The caption under the profile photo was removed: changing the photo opens by pressing the avatar.
A new look: the "Pumpkin latte" theme with autumn leaves, line icons and lists instead of cards on the home screen and the main screens.
Requests are grouped by state and duties by urgency; a request waiting for your answer got an "Answer" label.
In a new request the topic is picked with buttons, and the deadline can be set with one press: today, tomorrow or in a week.
The duty card shows the stages "created → completion → check"; the profile, hearts and the couple page are organized into lists of sections.
In the mood section the rating is picked with an icon, and a month calendar with a summary was added.

The bot's Telegram messages became shorter and clearer: a heading with the partner's name, deadlines in words ("today", "tomorrow"), short buttons in one row, the mood as five emoji, and the duty list split into "Overdue", "Today" and "Later".
The admin panel is split into an overview, balance, themes, icons, the home screen builder and the economy.
You can create shared themes with colours, a gradient, decorations and your own background; the look can change with the seasons.
Icons can be replaced with symbols or your own pictures, per theme or for the whole site at once.
The home screen builder lets you reorder and hide blocks and icons, set display conditions and add text cards, with a preview.
An administrator can add and take away hearts with a reason and a history entry; repeated submissions and the service reserve are protected.
The profile shows the photo, name, bio and number of recipes; the photo changes on press, and the partner's profile opens from the home screen.
A request shows its completion status; completion, the check and cancellation are available without extra navigation.
The shared chore and movie wheel waits for both partners and starts for them at the same time.
You can ask yourself about your mood through Telegram and share the answer with your partner.
A private admin panel was added, with statistics, a log and feature testing as a selected user.
Reconciliation of chosen test balances is recorded separately in the hearts history.
The partner's mood history opens by holding the card: pick a day and see the average rating and the entries with emoji and stickers.
The profile photo is visible to the partner on the home screen; adding to a mood no longer sends a second notification.
Illustrations were fixed and aligned, and the request text is highlighted.
Compliments from the profile appear on the partner's home screen and change every five minutes.
Reminders about unfinished obligations arrive at 10:00, 15:00 and 20:00 in the couple's time.
Movies can be added with a photo and a link, and picked by swiping together until the first match or with a shared wheel.
After both agree, the draw picks who does the chore and adds the obligation to them.
Data on open pages refreshes automatically; entered text is kept.
In Telegram answers take one press, and a mood can be supplemented with a regular, animated or video sticker.
The mood card became an ask button with a short toast.
Requests and the menu were simplified; cars appear after being added in the profile, and the time zone moved to the detailed settings.
A background with clouds and hearts, new illustrations and the user's photo in the bottom menu were added.
In Telegram a mood can be supplemented with your own emoji by sending it in reply to the bot.
The home screen highlights the partner's mood and emoji; the ask button became more compact.
In the profile you can upload and replace your own photo from the gallery.
A mood in Telegram is saved with one press; then the bot offers to add an emoji or skip the addition.
Asking about the mood again sends a new notification after a minute; quick presses are protected from duplicates.
A neutral mood was added in Telegram and in the app — in the middle of the list of options.
The sign-in is kept for 30 days of inactivity and extended on every visit.
You can ask about your partner's mood right away and answer in the app or in Telegram.
Requests became simpler: extra settings are collapsed, and agreeing with a condition is available explicitly.
You can ask your partner to rate an act and get a rating with a comment.
Favourite movies and a watch list, mutual matches and a pick roulette were added.
You can set the relationship start and wedding dates; the time together is shown in days, years and months.
A personal car adds a fill-up as a way of counter-payment.
After rating a mood you can pick an emoji; the home screen shows the partner's mood.
Telegram notifications contain the request description, the conditions and the deadlines, with no added links.
Telegram can be linked with a one-time code from the /start command: press the button with the code to copy it and paste it in the profile.
The bot receives messages and sends notifications when the app runs on a laptop, with no public address.
A separate way to run the app on a laptop for use over the local network was prepared.
Guides were added for saving data, updating and checking that the schedule works.
Installing the app on the phone's home screen and clear instructions for iPhone and Android were added.
With no network a separate screen is shown; actions need a connection, and personal pages are not saved for offline viewing.
The profile brings together personal data, currency, payment details, Telegram and links to sections; old money agreements are kept.
The money, date and reminder forms, the hearts ledger and the economy editor were updated, with setting groups, confirmations and shared navigation.
Duties are split into active, awaiting a check and completed; an answer is confirmed in a separate sheet.
The wishlist was updated: wish cards, gift states, manual adding with a photo preview and a confirmed archive.
A personal home screen was added: the partner, the length of the relationship, mood, hearts, the nearest duties and quick links.
The kitchen and the dish editor were updated: clear prices, reasons for unavailability and a photo preview.
A convenient counter-condition sheet was added, with a choice of kind, clearing of fields that do not apply and separate acceptance by the request author.
Telegram sign-in and linking were added, with a one-time link, code verification and completion in the original browser; an available photo is imported into private storage.
Quick bot buttons were added, with a separate confirmation, permission checks and protection against repeated actions, including payment and mood marks.
Notifications to the linked Telegram about requests, answers, duty checks, overdue duties and mood were added, with resending on failures.
Automatic mood questions by the couple's time and sending of one-off reminders were added, with protection for cancelled and stale entries.
Four mood ratings, showing them to the partner, a 30-day history and a personal schedule setting were added.
One-off reminders for the partner were added, with a choice of time, a status view and cancellation before delivery.
Personal friends and guest visits were added: choosing guests, the time, the duration and saving the agreed guest list.
Dates and shared activities were added, with a description, a dress code, the partner's answers and counter-conditions.
The kitchen was added: regular and special dishes, photos, a grocery estimate and a request to cook the selected dish.
A manual wishlist and gifts as a condition were added: one promise per wish, a separate confirmation of receipt and an archive.
Money requests and conditions were added, with an exact amount, a currency and private payment details; payment and receipt are confirmed separately.
Economy settings for the administrator and a history of rule changes were added.
Paid services were added: hearts are reserved after agreement and deducted after the check; mutual cancellation releases the reserve.
Categories, request templates and personal agreement methods were added, including a choice of sushi size.
Separate duties for a request and a counter-condition were added: the performer's mark and the partner's check.
A personal heart balance, a history of changes, one-time starting hearts and thanks for the partner were added.
Rewards, penalties and limits were connected; "Really want" respects the weekly quota, and the "No money for groceries" refusal stays without a penalty.
Requests for the partner with a required deadline, and agreement and refusal with confirmation, were added.
Counter-conditions with separate acceptance by the author, a history of versions and protection against repeated submission were added.
The "No money for groceries" refusal is saved without a penalty; heart deductions will be connected separately.
Agreeing on the weekly "Really want" limit was added: personal answers, a suggested compromise and confirmation by both partners.
New proposals can be discussed; the history is kept, and the previous rule stays in force until a new mutual agreement.
Creating a couple, inviting by link, accepting with confirmation and ending a couple were added.
The history is kept for former members and closed to a new partner.
Checks of simultaneous invitation acceptance in a separate test database were added.
The base of a new project was prepared, with a start page and a separate development environment.
A single look for the future couple app was added: a start page, section cards and hints.
Registration with a login and password, a personal profile and access recovery with a recovery code were added.
